svg.title: Interactive isometric developer desk and server rack
svg.desc: An isometric developer desk with a single wide monitor, a mechanical keyboard, a coffee mug, a rubber duck, and an open server rack with seven servers and a network switch, in sodium orange highlights. Click the monitor to power the computer, click the keyboard keys for light feedback, and click a server or press 1 to 7 to toggle it.

g.aria-label: Server 1, online. Click or press 1 to toggle.
